title: Nannas

paragraphs: The well-known Shimon ben Nannas. There is also an Abba Shaul ben Nannas in Avot deRabbi Natan 29:2, but Hyman calls this a scribal error: it should read simply Abba Shaul.[^1][^2]

notes.text: אבות דר״נ is conventionally Avot deRabbi Natan; פ״כט-ב is read as chapter 29 section 2, not a verified recension A/B marker or independently checked modern section.

ט״ס/צ״ל preserve Hyman’s definite scribal-error/should-read assertion; אך is simply. He proposes dropping ben Nannas from the Abba Shaul reading, without dropping the well-known Shimon ben Nannas or merging identities. Abba is explicit; no extra Rabbi title is supplied to either person.
